actions.action: Add a keyboard-accessible “Move to position” control.
actions.mechanism: Direct position entry avoids traversing up to 39 items to reach a chosen destination.
actions.implementation: Give each item a button opening a labeled integer input, 1–40. Enter commits through the undo journal; Escape cancels.
actions.check: Using only the keyboard, move item 37 to position 2, undo, and verify the exact original ID sequence.
actions.risk: Clarify that the number means position after moving.

actions.action: Offer an explicit keyboard reorder mode.
actions.mechanism: Arrow-key movement lets users adjust placement while retaining context among neighboring reading-list items.
actions.implementation: Activate an item’s “Reorder” button; arrows adjust a preview, Enter commits through the undo journal, and Escape cancels. Announce positions and retain focus.
actions.check: Without a pointer, move position 20 to 23 and undo. Verify announcements, retained focus, and unchanged item IDs.
actions.risk: Capture arrows only during reorder mode; provide visible instructions.

actions.action: Keep an undo journal until page close.
actions.mechanism: Retained order snapshots make every committed move reversible, rather than expiring reversal after a short notification.
actions.implementation: Before each commit, append the ID sequence to an uncapped page-session journal. Provide persistent keyboard-operable Undo; restore ordering without regenerating IDs.
actions.check: Commit 100 moves, dismiss notifications, then undo all 100. Compare every restored sequence with its snapshot and verify ID preservation.
actions.risk: Deletion or concurrent updates require explicit reconciliation before restoring snapshots.
